title: Inventory & Stock Health
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Stock value
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(sl.qty_on_hand * pr.unit_cost), 2) FROM dash_demo.stock_levels sl JOIN dash_demo.products pr USING (product_id) WHERE true

kpis.label: SKUs below reorder level
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.stock_levels sl JOIN dash_demo.products pr USING (product_id) WHERE sl.qty_on_hand < sl.reorder_level

kpis.label: Slow-mover value, no sale in 90 days
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(sl.qty_on_hand * pr.unit_cost), 2) FROM dash_demo.stock_levels sl JOIN dash_demo.products pr USING (product_id) WHERE (sl.last_sold_date IS NULL OR sl.last_sold_date < DATE '2026-09-30' - INTERVAL 90 DAY)

kpis.label: Rows in the stock table
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.stock_levels sl JOIN dash_demo.products pr USING (product_id) WHERE true AND sl.qty_on_hand < sl.reorder_level

kpis.label: Rotterdam DC, % of capacity
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(sl.qty_on_hand) / max(w.capacity_units), 2) FROM dash_demo.stock_levels sl JOIN dash_demo.warehouses w USING (warehouse_id) WHERE w.name = 'Rotterdam DC'
